<a id="continuation-relative-to-a-class--相对于类的续"></a>
# Continuation relative to a class

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`continuation-relative-to-a-class` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](continuation-relative-to-a-class.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For every carrier and relation, continuation is 缘 met with a class; its positions depend on the class, a class constant under 缘 never lets a continuation end, a line's own regularity is the class's core, and the World model's arising, ceasing, lineage and passing are its instances.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Continuation is 缘 met with a class: one occurrence continues another under a class where the first is a condition of the second and the two are alike under the class. A line is the reach of continuation, and an occurrence begins, abides or ends in it where it has no predecessor, both, or no successor; beginning and abiding exclude each other, as do abiding and ending, and every line runs along the reach of 缘. (`Becoming.«续»`, `Becoming.«相续»`, `Becoming.«有前»`, `Becoming.«有后»`, `Becoming.«生»`, `Becoming.«住»`, `Becoming.«亡»`, `Becoming.«异»`, `Becoming.«续含于缘»`, `Becoming.«相续含于及»`, `Becoming.«生住不并»`, `Becoming.«住亡不并»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. No position stands by itself: the positions depend on the class. Under the one, continuation is 缘 itself, and an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it; in a net without self-conditioning, an occurrence with a condition and a consequence abides under the one and both begins and ends under identity. (`Becoming.«一之续»`, `Becoming.«一之生»`, `Becoming.«四相无自立»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. Coarsening: under a coarser class every continuation remains one, so what ends under the coarser class ends under the finer and what abides under the finer abides under the coarser; something can end under the finer class and not end under the coarser. (`Becoming.«粗化»`, `Becoming.«亡于粗则亡于细»`, `Becoming.«住于细则住于粗»`, `Becoming.«亡于细者不必亡于粗»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. A class constant under 缘 (E˘;R ⊆ R;E˘) never lets a continuation end: whatever continues something is continued, symmetric class or not. So a class under which some line ends is not constant, and a line that ends has its own regularity in its class's core, not in the class. (`Becoming.«有常»`, `Becoming.«有常之逐点»`, `Becoming.«有常则续不尽»`, `Becoming.«有常则相续不尽»`, `Becoming.«有亡之续则不有常»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. The core of a class under 缘 lies inside it, is constant and symmetric, and contains every symmetric constant relation inside it: it is the greatest one, and the core of a class is a class. For a class, ending is kept along the core and, its mirror, beginning along the core of the converse net; the two-way core, constant both ways, lies inside both, so what it relates shares beginning, abiding and ending (altering, a relation between two occurrences with a finer class, is not a mark of one occurrence). (`Becoming.«核»`, `Becoming.«根»`, `Becoming.«核为类»`, `Becoming.«有常可复合»`, `Becoming.«静有常»`, `Becoming.«位核»`, `Becoming.«位根»`, `Becoming.«位核含于核»`, `Becoming.«位核含于逆核»`, `Becoming.«亡于核下不变»`, `Becoming.«生于逆核下不变»`, `Becoming.«生于位核下不变»`, `Becoming.«位同则生亡同»`, `Becoming.«位同则住同»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. Continuation is not defined through the core: in a flame of three moments ending in ash, the moments continue one another under 'flame or not', yet under that class's core no two occurrences continue one another, since the moments' futures differ by how long is left. (`Becoming.Flame`, `Becoming.Flame.step`, `Becoming.Flame.burns`, `Becoming.Flame.alike`, `Becoming.Flame.alike_class`, `Becoming.Flame.not_core_f₁`, `Becoming.Flame.not_core_f₀`, `Becoming.«以核为判据则火无续»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. For a class, constancy is exactly closure of the coarse net: E;R;E ⊆ R;E. Read without taking classes apart, every 缘 inside a class becomes a loop at both its ends; the coarse net therefore takes 缘 between classes, and it joins only different classes. (`Becoming.«闭合当且仅当有常»`, `Becoming.«类内之缘成环»`, `Becoming.«粗»`, `Becoming.«粗只连异类»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. Renewal: an occurrence renews where it is a condition of a beginning that goes on; renewal at the grain of a class reads the same relation at that grain, and every renewal is one at every grain. Renewal without end is the greatest family each member of which renews into a line reaching the family again; it renews. Under the one there is neither. (`Becoming.«复生»`, `Becoming.«粗复生»`, `Becoming.«复生则粗复生»`, `Becoming.«一之下无复生»`, `Becoming.«生生»`, `Becoming.«生生之展»`, `Becoming.«生生最大»`, `Becoming.«生生则复生»`, `Becoming.«一之下无生生»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Boundaries in the grammar itself: that every occurrence, in every model, either begins or has a predecessor is exactly excluded middle; under fission, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive; every single 缘 is a continuation under some class, and two conditions of one occurrence, each alike to it, make a merge: it continues both; reach is an order of precedence only where nothing reaches itself. (`Becoming.«四相之定当且仅当排中»`, `Becoming.«分叉»`, `Becoming.«同族»`, `Becoming.«同族为类»`, `Becoming.«任一缘可为续»`, `Becoming.«蜡烛之合»`, `Becoming.«无环»`, `Becoming.«无环则及为序»`, `Becoming.«不穷»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
10. Lines: a line under a class stays within it; a beginning under a finer class continued under a coarser one is an alteration; what begins under a coarser class begins under the finer; and where every step keeps a transitive relation (a class is one) or carries a mark, a line whose ends the relation tells apart has a marked step. (`Becoming.«线内同类»`, `Becoming.«生于细而续于粗则异»`, `Becoming.«生于粗则生于细»`, `Becoming.«两端分则中有标»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
11. Holding, mutual need and leaning-on through constancy apply only to lines that do not end; through the core they apply to all: a class suffices for another's regularity where what is alike under both is alike under the other's core. The constancy forms imply the core forms, mutual need through constancy is symmetric and nothing needs itself, a class is constant exactly where it lies in its core, and the core is monotone in the class. In the flame of three moments and its ash, "flame or not" and "the same fuel left" need each other through the core, and every class that with "flame or not" tells its four occurrences apart suffices for its regularity, so the witness singles out neither fuel nor a direction; in two flames side by side the fuel left suffices for the regularity of "flame or not" while the joint class relates two distinct occurrences (the two flames at one moment), and sameness of flame does not suffice. (`Becoming.«自持»`, `Becoming.«相须»`, `Becoming.«因于»`, `Becoming.«有常之同谓»`, `Becoming.«相须之对称»`, `Becoming.«无自相须»`, `Becoming.«核之单调»`, `Becoming.«类有常当且仅当含于核»`, `Becoming.«足以定核»`, `Becoming.«因于核»`, `Becoming.«相须核»`, `Becoming.«合有常则足以定核»`, `Becoming.«因于则因于核»`, `Becoming.«相须则相须核»`, `Becoming.Flame.fuel`, `Becoming.Flame.sameFuel`, `Becoming.Flame.joint_eq`, `Becoming.TwoFlames`, `Becoming.TwoFlames.step`, `Becoming.TwoFlames.alike`, `Becoming.TwoFlames.sameFuel`, `Becoming.TwoFlames.sameFlame`, `Becoming.«火薪相须»`, `Becoming.«火之见证不择类»`, `Becoming.«两火以薪定理»`, `Becoming.«两火同火不足以定理»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
12. Renewing into: an occurrence conditions a beginning whose line reaches another. Ceasing, defined positively and inductively along renewing into: an occurrence ceases where everything it renews into ceases, the least property so closed. Renewal without end, the greatest family each member of which renews into a member, does not cease («生生不息»). Ceasing concerns what an occurrence renews into, not its line: one that does not itself renew ceases, so one on whose line nothing renews ceases; under the one everything ceases. (`Becoming.«复生至»`, `Becoming.«息»`, `Becoming.«生生不息»`, `Becoming.«自不复生则息»`, `Becoming.«不复生则息»`, `Becoming.«一之下皆息»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
13. The World model's arising and ceasing along one relatum are beginning and ending under 'alike in activity', occurrences being pairs of a step and a relatum; ceasing to be is an ending and coming to be a beginning; the finite-world law of arising and ceasing is exactly the decidability of the positions. (`Becoming.Web.arises_iff_sheng`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff_late_beginnings`, `Becoming.Web.renews_iff`, `Becoming.Steps.next`, `Becoming.Steps.along`, `Becoming.Web.activityClass`, `Becoming.ceasesToBe_iff_wang`, `Becoming.comesToBe_iff_sheng`, `Becoming.Web.ceases_iff_wang`, `Becoming.positions_iff_em`, `Becoming.persists_of_positions`, `Becoming.core_iff_same_course`, `Becoming.Web.flash_positions`, `Becoming.World.law_iff_positions`, `Becoming.World.law_iff_grammar_positions`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
14. Relative to a continuation of the World model, arising and ceasing are its beginning and ending; a split is fission and a merge the candles' merge; lineages, continuing, links and holding are lines, unchanged by re-identification. (`Becoming.Web.continuationStep`, `Becoming.Web.arisesFrom_iff_sheng`, `Becoming.Web.ceasesFrom_iff_wang`, `Becoming.Web.split_fission`, `Becoming.Web.merge_candles`, `Becoming.Web.lineage_iff_line`, `Becoming.Web.positions_not_self_standing`, `Becoming.Web.reach_strict_order`, `Becoming.Web.continuing_iff_line`, `Becoming.Web.linked_iff_line`, `Becoming.Web.held_iff_line`, `Becoming.Web.RenewingAlong.branches`, `Becoming.Web.ConsumingAlong.merged_candles`, `Becoming.Web.line_reidentify`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
15. Passing a pattern on while the carrier ceases is an alteration, ending under the carrier class and continuing under the pattern's (火传); falling dormant is an alteration under holding, and choosing what holds is choosing a class. (`Becoming.Web.carrierClass`, `Becoming.Web.byPassing_iff_hasPred`, `Becoming.Web.passing_fire`, `Becoming.PatternRelay.fire_shape`, `Becoming.Web.stateClass`, `Becoming.Web.fallsDormant_alters`, `Becoming.Web.ceases_of_persisting_ceases`, `Becoming.Hibernation.positions`, `Becoming.Seed.held_classes`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the grammar: every carrier and every relation; where a theorem speaks of a class, the class is an equivalence relation.
- Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model, used where identity is a class (the positions under identity, the flame, the merge).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘; under the full relation every class is constant.
- That continuation contained in 缘 tells a fire passed on from one fire ending and another starting: every single 缘 is a continuation under some class, and two conditions each alike to their common outcome make a merge. Witness: `Becoming.«任一缘可为续»`.
- That renewal without end tells renewal that sustains life from turnover that destroys it.
- That reach orders occurrences where conditions are mutual: it is then a preorder.
- That the World model's counting, amounts, recurrence and renaming laws are instances: the grammar's counting on a region is not connected to the World model's, and the grammar states no map of carriers, so only their premises are connected.
- **Counterexample:** A flame of three moments ending in ash continues under 'flame or not' and has no continuation under that class's core («以核为判据则火无续»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Grammar.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Fission: one occurrence continued by two that go no further makes sameness along lines intransitive («分叉»). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Grammar.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

## Next

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

For a class, constancy is bisimulation equivalence (Park 1981; Milner 1989) and the core the greatest bisimulation inside the class; reach is the transitive closure of the calculus of relations (Tarski 1941). Continuation relative to a class is close to genidentity (Lewin 1922) and to Whitehead's enduring objects (1929); the closure law is the relational analogue of lumpability (Kemeny and Snell 1960) and of computational closure (Rosas et al. 2024), a correspondence not proved here. The classical readings (四相 in 《大乘起信论》, 六相 in 《金师子章》, 一实 in 《荀子·正名》, the refutation of 相續 in 《中论》) are registered with their losses in the plan.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [classes-along-a-continuation](classes-along-a-continuation.md). There formation classes are read along a given continuation of the World model, with splits and merges; here continuation itself is 缘 met with a class, for every carrier and relation.
- related, not a proved adapter: [a-pattern-lasts-through-passing](a-pattern-lasts-through-passing.md). A pattern outlasting its carriers there is a line under a class here; lifting it is the next step.
- related, not a proved adapter: [branching-tests-bisimulation](branching-tests-bisimulation.md). Bisimulation there is between labelled processes; here the core is the greatest symmetric relation constant under one relation inside a class.

### History

- 23 October 2026, board item OU1 (study section 371): the root of the one-unfolding plan in its tenth version, continuation relative to a class at its centre, after Ren's direction of that day and three reviews of the ninth version; the earlier claim that a line's regularity is its class being constant is corrected by «有常则续不尽».
- 23 October 2026, board items OU2 and OU3a (study section 372): the grammar gains holding, mutual need and leaning-on through the core for lines that end, ceasing and 生生不息, and four laws of lines moved down from PatternPassing and Persistence; the old continuation family is stated as its instances. The claim is widened to name the instances; the earlier laws are unchanged.
- 25 October 2026, board item OU6 (corrections to the grammar from the review of its sources, study section 400): the theorem on the two-way core renamed «位同则生亡同», since it shows only that beginning and ending carry over; the flame witness restated as mutual need through the core («火薪相须»), with the theorem that it picks no class and a two-flame model in which the fuel left is singled out against sameness of flame; ceasing defined positively, inductively, on renewing into («复生至»): what does not itself renew ceases («自不复生则息»), and the old reading implies the new («不复生则息»); the law on ending under a coarser class narrowed to what its theorem shows (not ending), and the law on the two-way core stated for a class, with abiding carried over too («位同则住同»). The claim is narrowed where a name or a reading said more than the Lean, and the new theorems are added; no other law changes.
- 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): the retired 'old base' named in current vocabulary, the World model, in the statement, two laws, a boundary and a related detail; the merge worded as the Lean states it, each of two conditions alike to the occurrence they condition (not to each other), in the ninth law and a boundary. No law changed in content.
- 30 October 2026: wording only, for the twenty-first review's item 13 (生生 in one sense): the theorem's name written «生生不息» in law 12, in English and Chinese, and the grammar's word «生生» in the Chinese of laws 8 and 12 and of the third item it does not show; nothing the record states changed.
- 31 October 2026, board item HE2 (study section 474). Item 1: «两端分则中有标» asks only that the relation it keeps be transitive (its hypotheses split, then trans, in place of a class), so law 10, in English and Chinese, now reads a transitive relation, a class being one; its declarations are unchanged. Items 6 and 7: the core's names «足以定理», «合有常则足以定理» renamed to «足以定核», «合有常则足以定核», with no alias kept, since off a class or a fixed successor the core need not be a 理; wording only in statement (zh), law 4 (zh), law 11 (zh): 理 written for a line's regularity, the core, becomes 规律 or 核; these renames and rewordings change no statement's content. The landing: does-not-show item 5's reason no longer says the grammar states no counting, since GrammarLaws counts on a region; Grammar's counts in the validation scope corrected to the receipt (stale since OU6).
- 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): law 5 generalized, as the corpus's family of 前際 and 後際 needed (conditional-laws-of-the-corpus): beginning is kept along the core of the converse net («生于逆核下不变»), which holds the two-way core («位核含于逆核»), the mirror of ending kept along the core; «生于位核下不变» is proved as its case, its statement unchanged.
